tierReason: Adds checklist and label tables, their API endpoints and offline sync to tasks

decisions.decision: Phone QA of #7 starts with npm run dev:phone from this checkout, after db:deploy on the dev database (already applied: migration 20261112164613_checklists_labels)
decisions.why: Expo on the default .env talks to Render (main), where the new routes don't exist yet

findings.text: waitingLabels.ts:53 taskChangesToResend + TasksProvider.setTaskLabels: labels are folded into a task change that can sit ahead of the waiting label create. Offline, the head change has attempts>0 (not in flight) so labels merge into it; on reconnect PATCH gets 400 validation_failed and the status edit + labels are lost. Second path: moving an unattempted task create to the end lets its queued checklist/item creates run first and 404. Fix: send task labels as their own change that always lands after the label create; never move creates. Tests: attempted head update; task create with a checklist queued behind.

syncCycle.ts label onRejected + queue runPass: R15 strip of a duplicate label from waiting task-label changes runs async after the queue has moved on, so the next PATCH carrying the label is usually already in flight; it gets 400, other fields in it are lost and the notice is overwritten. checklistSync.test.ts:247 hides it with a failing patchTask. Fix: strip synchronously before the queue moves on (e.g. in the label create sender) and/or separate task-labels changes; test with a succeeding patchTask.
apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts labels branch: one invalid label id 400s the whole task PATCH and rolls back other fields (follows AC8; worsens blocking 1-2 unless labels are sent separately).
apps/mobile/src/tasks/sync.ts task create sender: createTask then patchTask(labels); a refused label patch reports 'couldn't create the task' though the task was created.
checklistSync.test.ts:207: test name says the local copy is left but it asserts the item is removed; rename.
apps/api/src/labels/routes.test.ts: AC12 for labels not tested directly (PATCH after delete gives 404).
apps/api/src/tasks/routes.ts taskInclude: unpaged GET /tasks now nests checklists/items; worst case 1000x10x50 rows (~100MB). Cap, page or note the accepted limit.
apps/mobile/src/tasks/store.ts isTask: checklist and item entries aren't shape-checked; a malformed one would crash checklist.items.map on render.
labels/pick.tsx: selected drops task label ids the phone doesn't know yet; a toggle then removes them from the task on the server. Keep unknown ids in the sent set.

(sensitive) TasksProvider.tsx:526-531 + waitingLabels.ts:50-62: setTaskLabels moves a task's waiting changes (including an offline create) behind a label create, so the task's checklist/item creates reach the server first, 404, and are removed locally (AC14 scenario). The move is dropEntity then enqueue, so a kill between them loses the task create. Same root cause as finding 1.

(sensitive) migration 20261112164613_checklists_labels line 9 DROP DEFAULT on Task.labelsEditedAt: render.yaml runs db:deploy before the new code starts, so the old server's task.create (no labelsEditedAt) returns 500 during rollout, and stays broken if the new deploy fails its health check. Keep a default (new follow-up migration, since this one is applied to dev).

(sensitive) TasksProvider.tsx:497-512 deleteLabel strips the label from waiting task-label changes before the server accepts the delete; a refused delete (Member, offline demotion) doesn't undo that. Strip only for Owners or after acceptance.
(sensitive) apps/api/src/labels/routes.ts:190: a duplicate-name rename rolls back a colour change sent in the same request. Consistent, noted only.
(sensitive) GET /tasks response size grows with nested checklists/items (same as finding 7).

(fix review) TasksProvider.tsx ~L503 deleteLabel + sync.ts ~L179-193: when a label's create is still waiting unsent, enqueue(delete) removes create+delete together, so the delete sender (which now strips) never runs; the waiting taskLabels set still names L; on reconnect PATCH [A, L] is refused 400 and A is lost (regression vs R7/R14/R15). Fix: strip at once in deleteLabel when the label's create is waiting with no attempts; keep the post-delete strip otherwise. Test: create L, set [A, L], delete L, flush -> PATCH [A].

(fix review) TasksProvider.tsx ~L433: deleting a task drops its waiting taskLabels set before the delete is accepted; a refused delete (403) loses that set. Matches existing update-then-delete folding.
(fix review) waitingLabels.ts stripLabelFromWaiting: reads waiting() then enqueues with a fresh time; a pick made in between can be replaced. Tiny window, pre-existing pattern.
(fix review) waitingLabels.ts queueTaskLabels: drop then enqueue; a crash between loses only that task's label set, restored by refresh. Acceptable, commented.
(fix review) syncCycle.ts taskLabels rejection: taskTitle can be null -> 'Your labels for the task  couldn't be saved.' Use an untitled variant like outcomes.ts named branch.
(fix review) store.ts isTask stricter: one corrupted cached task makes the whole cache read as null and refetch. Only for corrupted caches.

(last fix review) waitingLabels.ts:44-45 queueLabelDelete strips before enqueueing the delete; if that enqueue fails to persist, the sets lost the label but the label and its create remain. Suggest enqueue first, then strip if the create is gone from waiting().
(last fix review) waitingLabels.ts:41-43 copies the queue's create+delete drop rule; if queue.ts changes it the helper silently stops matching. The reorder above removes the copy.

1.evidence: API tests in apps/api/src/checklists/routes.test.ts: name 0/60/61, text 0/200/201, control chars, 11th checklist and 51st item refused, new item not done (gate test: API 422/422).
1.criterion: API tests: checklist name and item text of 0 and over the limit after trimming, or with control characters, are refused with `validation_failed`; 60 and 200 characters are accepted; an 11th checklist on a task and a 51st item in a checklist are refused with a clear error; a new item is not done.

2.evidence: API tests 'keeps creation order after edits' and repeated-create in checklists/routes.test.ts.
2.criterion: API test: checklists and items are returned in creation order, whatever order they were last edited in.

3.evidence: API tests: Member does everything on an Owner's task; checklist delete removes items; task delete cascades.
3.criterion: API tests: a Member can add, rename and delete a checklist and add, edit, tick and delete items on a task created by the Owner; deleting a checklist removes its items; deleting the task removes its checklists and items.

4.evidence: API tests: repeat create returns 200 with stored copy; concurrent double create makes one; id under another task/project gives id_conflict and leaves the original unchanged.
4.criterion: API tests: a checklist and an item created with phone-chosen UUIDs keep them; sending the same create twice leaves one; reusing an id from another task is refused and doesn't change the original.

5.evidence: Unit test apps/mobile/src/tasks/progress.test.ts: null with no items; 3 of 7 across two checklists; per-checklist counts.
5.criterion: Unit test of progress: 0 items gives no progress; items across two checklists with 3 of 7 done give `3/7` for the task and the right count per checklist.

6.evidence: API tests apps/api/src/labels/routes.test.ts: name length, unknown colour, 51st label, case/space/diacritics duplicate refused with label_name_taken.
6.criterion: API tests: label names of 0 and 31 characters, an unknown colour key, and a 51st label are refused; a name equal to an existing one apart from case and spaces is refused with a clear duplicate error.

7.evidence: API tests: Member create/rename/recolour allowed; Member delete 403; Owner delete removes the label from tasks; project delete removes labels.
7.criterion: API tests: a Member can create, rename and recolour a label; a Member deleting one gets `403`; an Owner deleting one removes it from every task that had it; deleting a project removes its labels.

8.evidence: API tests apps/api/src/tasks/routes.test.ts: setting labels; another project's label, unknown id, duplicate and 11th label refused with nothing changed.
8.criterion: API tests: putting a label on a task works; a label from another project, an unknown label id, the same label twice, or an 11th label are refused with `validation_failed`.

9.evidence: API tests: tasks return labelIds and checklists with items in order; labels list returns only the project's labels (id, name, colour).
9.criterion: API test: reading tasks returns each task's label ids and checklists with items in order; reading labels returns id, name and colour for that project only.

10.evidence: API tests: 401 not_signed_in without token and with an expired one on every checklist and label route; identical 404 body for non-member, cross-task, cross-project and malformed ids.
10.criterion: API tests: every new or changed endpoint without a token, or with an expired one, gives `401 not_signed_in`; a project the caller isn't in, and a checklist, item or label from another task or project, give `404` with the same body.

11.evidence: API tests: older done ignored while newer text accepted; same for label colour vs name; future time capped; label set replaced as a whole by the newer one; ignored change returns 200 with current state.
11.criterion: API tests: an older change to an item's done state is ignored while a newer change to its text in the same request is accepted; the same for a label's colour and name; a future time is stored as the server's time; a task's labels are replaced as a whole set by the newer change; an ignored change returns `200` with the current state.

12.evidence: API tests: change to a deleted item, checklist or label gives 404.
12.criterion: API test: a change to a deleted item, checklist or label gives `404`.
